createdBy: operator identity (roles/owner); the migration principal holds no index authority
method: Firestore Admin API POST collectionGroups/{cg}/indexes, one index at a time, each polled to READY before the next was created

indexes.useCase: FirestoreTravelRepository.listTripsForBusiness: tenant + deletion state + start-date cursor, 25-result page.
indexes.freeTierImpact: Serves the common travel list screen from an index instead of a tenant-wide scan.

indexes.useCase: Same screen with a status filter applied.
indexes.freeTierImpact: Same page bound; without it the scan dominates regardless of the filter.

indexes.useCase: FirestoreTravelDashboardRepository.listDashboardTrips paymentDate half (lines 73-74), reached from Dashboard.tsx:148. Year range bound at DASHBOARD_TRIPS_BOUND = 2000, no explicit orderBy so the implicit order is paymentDate then __name__.
indexes.freeTierImpact: Without it the landing screen scans the tenant's entire live trips collection on every load while its startDate sibling reads an index.

notCreated.reason: Not a hard-required gate. The mission permits creating only indexes classified as hard-required gates, so it was deliberately left unprovisioned.

cleanup: Delete only by exact resource name, e.g. gcloud firestore indexes composite delete projects/mydesckpro/databases/default/collectionGroups/trips/indexes/CICAgJiUsZIK --project=mydesckpro --database=default. Never wildcard.
